description:
Hi! We are working on developing a Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions. Our project aims to provide real-time vital signs tracking, AI-driven health risk assessment, and early warnings for astronauts during long-duration space missions.
​About Me/Us:
Passionate about space technology, software development, and biomedical engineering. We are looking to build an innovative solution that enhances astronaut safety and well-being.
